prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Objective tests go against the complaints: imaging is normal and the patient moved freely when observed outside the exam room.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, with a reported distal radius fracture of the wrist. The mechanism of injury and the force described are consistent with the type of fracture reported. Treatment was provided over 18 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury. Plain radiographs and follow-up imaging showed no fracture displacement or residual abnormality, and objective findings on examination were not consistent with the degree of pain and restricted movement the patient described. Staff also observed the patient moving the wrist freely outside the examination room. No prior injury to the same area is known from the history obtained. Billing records reviewed show no repeated or duplicate charges for the same services. Ongoing care will focus on symptom review, range-of-motion monitoring, and a return-to-activity plan based on objective findings.
